span.p:
SC-008 exception, should
Given The same manager reads another finding on section 7: a requirement names "the dispatch database", which is a part of the product.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When They refute the finding and say the requirement should keep the words.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see the finding checked against the document, and the document supports it

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: They see the reason stated once

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They keep their decision, and see it recorded as an objection

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: At the next grading pass, they see no new finding about the same words

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The objection and the expert's decision are recorded, the reason is stated only once, and the next grading pass does not raise the same finding as new.
